bagPolicy.summary: K-State permits clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches and approved small personal bags. Breast pumps may be carried in a dedicated inspected medical bag or compliant clear bag.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking opens two hours before tipoff. Men’s basketball general parking costs $12 in advance or $15 at the gate; women’s basketball costs $10 in advance or $12 at the gate, and charter buses cost $30.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions operate on the concourse when gates open, and ticket office, concession, parking, and retail points are cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Bramlage Coliseum provides accessible seating, parking, and service-animal accommodations under its A–Z guide.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: A ticket logged at entry cannot be reused by another guest; unrestricted re-entry is not permitted.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: A photo ID is required for all will-call orders. The Athletics Ticket Office may reissue lost season tickets only to the ticket holder of record.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Gates open one hour before tipoff. Events expected to draw 5,000 or more guests use security screening.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
